description: Hi! I’m a Computer Science (AI & ML) student with strong skills in C, Java, and algorithmic problem-solving. I’m passionate about building reliable, real-time software for space exploration. Join CodeX to build an innovative health monitoring system for astronauts—we focus on clean execution, practical architecture, and rapid prototyping. Looking for teammates skilled in UI/UX design, data visualization, web/app development, or biomedical/human factors to bring this project to life!
summary:
ASTRA CARE – AI-Powered Astronaut Healthcare and Monitoring Platform

ASTRA CARE is a smart healthcare and monitoring platform designed to support astronaut health and safety during space missions, especially long-duration and deep-space exploration. During space missions, astronauts face various health challenges, and communication delays with Earth can make medical assistance difficult. ASTRA CARE aims to bring essential healthcare features together in one centralized platform.

The project consists of six major modules:

1. Astronaut Health Monitoring: Displays important health indicators such as pulse rate, oxygen levels and body temperature.
2. Health Data and Historical Records: Organizes health information and previous records to track changes over time.
3. AI Predictive Health Analytics: Supports the analysis of health patterns and identification of potential health risks.
4. AI Medical Guidance: Provides a conversational interface for accessing medical information and guidance.
5. Medicine Inventory: Helps monitor available medicines and medical supplies.
6. Deep Space Mission Control: Provides a dedicated interface for mission-related information and control access.

The main objective of ASTRA CARE is to improve astronaut healthcare information management, support early identification of potential health concerns and make medical resources easier to access. The platform aims to contribute to safer and more independent future space exploration.

6. Deep Space Mission Control: Provides a dedicated interface for mission-related information and control access.

Our main objective is to improve healthcare information management, support early identification of potential health concerns, and make medical resources easier to access during space missions.
